HugsLib_logs_github_token_tip: Publishes logs to your own GitHub account when set. Paste a token from GitHub > Settings > Developer Settings > Personal access tokens. Leave blank to publish to the public HugsLib account.\n\nLogs published to your account can only be viewed by others using a link.
HugsLib_logs_platformInfo_tip: Includes information about your CPU, memory and video card in the log.
HugsLib_logs_shareConfirmMessage:
Upload game logs now?

This will post your game logs to a public server and give you the link to share with others. This is useful if you need help fixing a problem or would like to report an issue to a mod author.

No private information will be shared.
HugsLib_logs_shortUrls_tip: Produces a shorter link when uploading. Not recommended on Steam- short links are automatically removed.
HugsLib_logs_unlimitedLogSize_tip: When disabled, log size is limited to 10K lines to prevent very long logs from causing issues.
HugsLib_restart_language_text: The game language has changed. The game will now restart automatically.

HugsLib_setting_showNews_desc: Allows newly installed mods to highlight their new features in a pop-up window when you start your game.
